name: adblocker
description: Blocks ads and trackers with the standard filter lists (EasyList, EasyPrivacy, Peter Lowe's; uBlock filters, annoyances and cookie banners when you turn them on), hides the empty ad boxes left on the page, and lets you allow a site in one click. Click it to choose lists, update them, add your own filters, import your own lists (a file, a folder, a hosts or domain list) or subscribe to one by its address and see what it blocked on this page. The engine is Clear Glass's (src/adblock); this plugin is how you reach it.
author: James Brooks (Erosmancer)
